verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS platform with an official CLI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics opt-out, or related privacy controls for the web app or the CLI. Role-based access permissions are a different capability and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
